articles.headline: Inside the disunited United States that shadows the WNBA
articles.description: Sophie Cunningham said what she said about transgender women in sports. Now others want their say, whether the WNBA wants to hear them or not.

images.name: Sophie Cunningham [800x450]
images.caption: Sophie Cunningham, who has become a polarizing figure in the WNBA since sharing her opinion on transgender women in sports, signs autographs Friday night before Indiana's game at Portland.

images.name: Sophie Cunningham [800x450]
images.caption: "I'm here to play basketball," Cunningham said Friday night before scoring 13 points in Indiana's win over Portland.

images.name: Sophie Cunningham celebration [800x450]
images.caption: Cunningham drew more boos than cheers, but that didn't dampen her celebration on a night when she made three 3-pointers.

images.name: Sophie Cunningham supporters [800x450]
images.caption: Cunningham drew supporters in Portland and Seattle. Another rally is reportedly scheduled for the Fever's game in Minnesota on Sunday.

images.name: Portland protest [800x533]
images.caption: Demonstrators on both sides of the transgender athlete issue showed up outside the Moda Center Friday night in Portland.
